weekend.label: Friday, August 14 – Sunday, August 16, 2026
weekend.coreNote: Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky and standout events within about 90 minutes

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Friday day session
events.description: First-round ATP and WTA tennis across the Center Court campus; gates open at 9:30 AM for the 11 AM session.

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Friday night session
events.description: A separate first-round night session under the lights; gates open at 5 PM and play starts at 7 PM.

events.title: Great Inland Seafood Festival — Friday
events.description: A riverfront seafood blowout with whole Maine lobster, crab boils, gator, oysters and live sets by Shuffle and Vinyl Countdown.

events.title: Charm at the Farm — Friday VIP market
events.description: First access to more than 115 artisans, vintage finds, seasonal décor, food and drinks on a 56-acre horse farm; Friday tickets include re-entry all weekend.

events.title: Cincinnati Antique Jewelry Festival
events.venue: The Barn at Woman’s Art Club
events.description: A curated festival of Georgian, Victorian, Art Nouveau, Art Deco, retro and designer pieces from regional dealers.

events.title: From Antique to Vintage Jewelry — Beth Bernstein
events.venue: The Barn at Woman’s Art Club
events.description: The jewelry historian and author traces coveted designs, craftsmanship and cultural influences, followed by a Q&A.

events.title: Much Ado About Nothing in Ault Park
events.description: Cincinnati Shakespeare Company brings mistaken identities, overheard conversations and joyful chaos to a picnic-style park performance.

events.title: Reds vs. Marlins + Rick Ross postgame concert
events.description: Friday baseball ends with a field-level Rick Ross performance; the game also recognizes Veterans and Military Appreciation Day.

events.title: Ryan Hamilton at Liberty Funny Bone
events.description: Two Friday performances from the clean-observational stand-up comic; doors open one hour before each show.

events.title: Aldo Nova
events.description: The Canadian rock singer-guitarist behind “Fantasy” brings a full evening show to the intimate Ludlow Garage.

events.title: Love in the Club — 2000s Hip-Hop & R&B Party
events.description: A throwback club night built around 2000s hip-hop and R&B at Bogart’s.

events.title: The Mountain Goats
events.description: John Darnielle’s beloved literary indie-rock band headlines the historic Taft Theatre.

events.title: River & Rail with Hayden Haynes
events.description: A Nashville indie-folk/Americana duo with close harmonies, agile vocals and story-forward songwriting.

events.title: Reggae in the Lounge with DJ Abiyah + Ruff Neck Sounds
events.description: A late-night boundary-blurring mix of dancehall, electronica, new wave, avant hip-hop and reggae selectors.

events.title: A Magic Show for Sports Fans
events.description: The Game Changing Magic Tour combines sports culture and live illusion in one of OTR’s handsomest independent rooms.

events.title: Courtney Barnett — Creature of Habit Tour
events.description: The Australian singer-songwriter brings her incisive, deadpan indie rock to the riverfront pavilion.

events.title: Vinyl Countdown at the Seafood Festival
events.description: A free evening band set on the seafood festival stage, with the riverfront food village open until 11 PM.

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Saturday day session
events.description: First- and second-round play across the tournament grounds; gates open at 9:30 AM.

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Saturday night session
events.description: A separate second-round night session; gates open at 5 PM.

events.title: Great Inland Seafood Festival — Saturday
events.description: The festival’s longest day pairs seafood vendors with Sunburners, K9 Jack and The Lady Joya Band.

events.title: Charm at the Farm — Saturday market
events.description: Shop the open-air farm market’s artisans, vintage vendors, food and fall-leaning finds; timed early-bird and general-admission entry applies.

events.title: The City Flea
events.description: Cincinnati’s curated urban flea returns with local makers, vintage finds, art, home goods and food around Washington Park.

events.title: Black Family Reunion Parade
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.description: Grand Marshals William and Kathy Young lead the 38th annual parade from The Banks to Sawyer Point.

events.title: Black Family Reunion + Kenny Lattimore
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.description: Family programming, Black-owned vendors and community activations lead into a free main-stage performance by Kenny Lattimore.

events.title: Taste of India Cincinnati
events.address: 720 Barg Salt Run Rd, Cincinnati, OH 45244
events.description: Authentic Indian food, traditional and modern dance, cultural performances, vendors and family activities fill the temple grounds.

events.title: Cincinnati Antique Jewelry Festival — Saturday
events.venue: The Barn at Woman’s Art Club
events.description: The second day of the region’s curated antique, estate and vintage jewelry gathering.

events.title: Happily Indie After
events.description: An all-day gathering for independent authors and readers at the Sharonville Convention Center.

events.title: Cincinnati Hamfest & ARRL Great Lakes Convention
events.description: Radio gear, vendors, license exams, demonstrations and door prizes make this one of the weekend’s most wonderfully specific gatherings.

events.title: Cincinnati Bengals Training Camp
events.description: A rare close-up look at a Bengals practice session beside Paycor Stadium; check the official ticket listing before going.

events.title: Bearcats Volleyball vs. Wright State
events.description: UC women’s volleyball hosts Wright State in an early-season match at Fifth Third Arena.

events.title: Brew Bash at Rhinegeist
events.description: A festival-style showcase of 18 DIY heavy, punk and alternative bands rotating across two rooms, with local beer available.

events.title: Pool Run 5K
events.description: Run an open-course 5K through OTR, cross the finish line by jumping into Ziegler Pool fully dressed, then stay for pizza and a pool party.

events.title: Reds vs. Marlins — Harry Potter Night
events.description: A baseball night for witches, wizards and Muggles, with randomly distributed Reds mascot Hogwarts-house bobbleheads while supplies last.

events.title: Ryan Hamilton at Liberty Funny Bone
events.description: Two Saturday performances from the clean-observational stand-up comic; doors open roughly one hour before showtime.

events.title: The Concert — A Tribute to ABBA
events.description: A full-band celebration of ABBA’s biggest disco-pop songs in the Hard Rock ballroom.

events.title: Todd Rundgren
events.description: The endlessly inventive songwriter, producer and art-rock figure plays the Newport riverfront venue.

events.title: An Evening with Chris Smither
events.description: A close-listening evening with the veteran blues-folk songwriter in the Southgate House sanctuary.

events.title: Cincinnati Noir
events.description: A monthly gothic, industrial, new-wave and alternative-’80s dance night from DJs Impossible and Revelator.

events.title: Belt Fest
events.description: An independent festival-night booking at the Woodward Theater; use the venue page for the final lineup and ticket availability.

events.title: Little Miami Cardboard Boat Regatta
events.description: Dozens of homemade cardboard boats attempt the lake course in a cheerful spectacle that drew more than 2,500 people last year.

events.title: Dayton Germanfest Picnic — Saturday
events.description: Authentic schnitzel, German bier and wine, live bands, dancing, culture displays and family programming in a historic neighborhood.

events.title: Dayton African American Cultural Festival
events.description: A regional culture festival with music, food, art and community programming at Island MetroPark.

events.title: Bernheim CONNECT
events.description: A standout after-dark convergence of art, music, science and illuminated installations around Lake Nevin.

events.title: 50th Woodland Art Fair — Saturday
events.description: Nearly 200 nationally selected artists, food and live music fill one of Kentucky’s largest free cultural events.

events.title: Racing Louisville vs. Boston Legacy FC
events.description: A high-stakes NWSL match billed as Down the Stretch Night in one of the league’s best soccer-specific stadiums.

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Sunday day session
events.description: Second-round day-session tennis across Center Court and the surrounding grounds.

events.title: Cincinnati Open — Sunday night session
events.description: A separate second-round night session; gates open at 5 PM.

events.title: Great Inland Seafood Festival — Sunday
events.description: The closing riverfront session pairs seafood vendors with City Slickers at noon, Britney’s Lipstick at 3 and Whiskey Town at 6.

events.title: BFR Kids Got Talent
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.description: Young local performers take the children’s pavilion stage during the Black Family Reunion’s closing day.

events.title: Black Family Reunion Gospel Celebration — John P. Kee
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.description: The four-day reunion closes with a free Sunday gospel celebration headlined by John P. Kee.

events.title: Ice Cream & Opera
events.description: Cincinnati Opera vocalists perform a tailor-made outdoor set; bring a picnic or blanket and visit the on-site ice cream truck.

events.title: Music at the Esplanade
events.description: Low-key live music, food, beer and river views create an easy Sunday-evening landing spot.

events.title: Reds vs. Marlins — Run the Bases Day
events.description: Sunday afternoon baseball followed by a chance for fans of all ages to line up and run the bases.

events.title: The Early November with Footballhead
events.description: Emo and melodic indie rock close the weekend in the Southgate House sanctuary.

events.title: PJ Morton — Saturday Night Sunday Morning Tour
events.description: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter and keyboardist brings his soul-forward tour to Bogart’s.

events.title: Dayton Germanfest Picnic — Sunday
events.description: The closing day adds the festival’s Polka Mass and all-German car show to the food, biergarten and live entertainment.

events.title: Dayton African American Cultural Festival — Sunday
events.description: The festival’s second day continues with culture, music, food, art and community programming.

events.title: 50th Woodland Art Fair — Sunday
events.description: The final day of the major juried fair features nearly 200 artists, food and live performances in Woodland Park.
